'''Gilbert Alexander Pontes Burns''' (born 20 July 1986) is a Brazilian and American former professional [[Mixed martial arts|mixed martial artist]] and [[Submission grappling|submission grappler]]. He competed in the [[Welterweight (MMA)|Welterweight]] division of the [[Ultimate Fighting Championship]] (UFC) where he was a challenger for the [[UFC Welterweight Championship|UFC Welterweight championship]] in February 2021.

Burns is an [[World Jiu-Jitsu Championship|IBJJF World Jiu-Jitsu Champion]] (gi and no-gi), [[Campeonato Brasileiro de Jiu-Jitsu|CBJJ Brazilian Champion]], [[Abu Dhabi World Professional Jiu-Jitsu Championship|UAEJJF World Pro Champion]], [[European IBJJF Jiu-Jitsu Championship|European Open]] medallist,<ref name="BJJBurns">{{cite web |url=http://www.bjjheroes.com/bjj-fighters/gilbert-burns-durinho-facts-and-bio |title=BJJ Heroes on Gilbert Burns |publisher=bjjheroes.com |access-date=2014-05-26}}</ref> and [[ADCC Submission Fighting World Championship]] medallist.

He is the older brother of former [[Ultimate Fighting Championship|UFC]] fighter [[Herbert Burns]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Herbert Burns wants a fast track to One FC title |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2014/8/29/6078457/herbert-burns-wants-a-fast-track-to-one-fc-featherweight-title |last=Cruz |first=Guilherme |date=2014-08-29}}</ref>

==Background==
Burns was born in [[Niterói, Rio de Janeiro|Niterói]], as one of three brothers. During their childhood, he and his younger brother, former UFC fighter [[Herbert Burns]], suffered from severe attacks of [[asthma|asthmatic bronchitis]]. Upon medical recommendation to help manage the condition, they began practicing sports at the age of four, getting their first martial arts experience through [[karate]] sessions in their backyard.<ref name="mmaf20"/>

Their definitive transition to Brazilian jiu-jitsu happened in 1998, after the brothers found a [[Brazilian jiu-jitsu gi|gi]] in the trunk of a car belonging to one of their father's clients. Their father worked as an [[upholstery|upholsterer]], and the car's owner, a coach named Luiz Carlos, offered the three boys three months of free BJJ lessons in exchange for repairing his car seats. Due to the family's severe financial struggles at the time, the eldest brother, Frederick, gave up his competitive career in 2003 to work and help support the household. He would later become a combat diver for the [[Brazilian Navy]]'s Special Operations.<ref name="agfight">{{cite web|author=Carlos Antunes|url=https://agfight.com/entrevistas/incentivador-no-esporte-e-culpado-por-apelido-conheca-o-irmao-mais-velho-de-durinho/|title=Incentivador no esporte e ‘culpado’ por apelido: conheça o irmão mais velho de ‘Durinho’|date=February 12, 2021|access-date=April 20, 2026|website=agfight.com|language=pt-BR}}</ref><ref name="uol21">{{cite web|url=https://www.uol.com.br/esporte/reportagens-especiais/ufc-durinho-sobe-ao-octogono-para-buscar-o-cinturao-em-nome-do-irmao-que-teve-que-desistir-por-falta-de-dinheiro/|title=Grande irmão: Durinho sobe ao octógono para buscar o cinturão em nome de Fred, que, pelo irmão mais novo, desistiu de lutar|website=uol.com.br|author=Brunno Carvalho|date=February 13, 2021|access-date=April 20, 2026|language=pt-BR}}</ref>

Burns began his formal training at the Associação Oriente Academy in Niterói. His famous nickname, "Durinho", originated when the brothers started training at the [[Nova União (mixed martial arts)|Nova União]] headquarters in Rio de Janeiro. Frederick was known as "Todo Duro" (roughly translated as "All Stiff")—a moniker given to him by veteran [[Vítor Ribeiro|Vitor "Shaolin" Ribeiro]] due to his stiff movement style. Because Gilbert was the younger brother but still displayed remarkable toughness during sparring, "Shaolin" dubbed him "Durinho" (the diminutive form, meaning "Little Tough Guy").<ref name="agfight"/><ref name="mmaf20"/>

At the age of 18, Burns secured his first sponsorship, which allowed him to cover his training expenses and financially assist his family. Initially, he enrolled in college to study [[Physical education]], but dropped out in 2007 to focus entirely on his competitive jiu-jitsu career. He subsequently relocated to [[Rio Claro, São Paulo|Rio Claro]] in the state's countryside. During this period, he struggled to make rent and dealt with recurring bronchitis attacks, but was ultimately persuaded by his older brother to not abandon the sport.<ref name="uol21"/>

==Grappling career==
He trained with [[Nova União (mixed martial arts)|Nova União]] until the 2007 World Championship, where he came in second place.<ref name="BJJBurns"/>

In 2009, Burns became recognized when he won the silver medal at the [[World Jiu-Jitsu Championship#2009 Men's Black Belt World Champions|World Jiu-Jitsu Championship]].<ref name="BJJBurns"/>

In 2010, Burns attained a high level of international success competing worldwide.  He reached the semifinals of the European Open in January; he defeated heavy favorite Celso Venicius at the World Pro Cup trials; he won the World Cup finals in [[Abu Dhabi]] against Claudio Mattos, and he won the [[Brasileiros|Brazilian Nationals]] in May.<ref name="BJJBurns"/>

In 2011, Burns achieved his highest recognition as he won the gold medal in the [[World Jiu-Jitsu Championship#2011 Men's Black Belt World Champions|2011 World Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Championships]].<ref name="BJJBurns"/>

In 2015, Burns won bronze at Abu Dhabi Submission Wrestling championships ([[ADCC Submission Fighting World Championship|ADCC]]).

In November 2020, Burns challenged [[Nate Diaz]] to a grappling match on an upcoming Submission Underground event, but the match didn't come to fruition.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://jitsmagazine.com/gilbert-burns-challenges-nate-diaz-to-400k-grappling-match-on-submission-underground/ | title=Gilbert Burns Challenges Nate Diaz to $400k Grappling Match on Submission Underground | date=13 November 2020 }}</ref>

Burns faced [[Rafael Lovato Jr.]] in the main event of [[FloSports#Who's Number One (WNO)|Who's Number One]] on 30 April 2021 and won a unanimous decision.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://jitsmagazine.com/whos-number-one-rafael-lovato-jr-v-gilbert-burns-full-results-and-review/ | title=Who's Number One: Rafael Lovato Jr v Gilbert Burns Full Results and Review | date=May 2021 }}</ref>

He then fought against [[Lucas Barbosa (martial artist)|Lucas Barbosa]] in the main event of BJJ Stars 7 on 6 November 2021. Burns lost by submission after being caught in a rear-naked choke.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://jitsmagazine.com/bjj-stars-7-full-results-and-review/ | title=BJJ Stars 7 Full Results and Review | date=9 November 2021 }}</ref>

Burns faced Horlando Monteiro in his [[UFC BJJ]] debut at UFC BJJ 9 on June 4, 2026.<ref>{{Cite web|author=Guilherme Cruz|date=2026-05-24|title=Gilbert Burns gets opponent, date set for UFC BJJ debut|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/ufc/489916/gilbert-burns-gets-opponent-date-set-for-ufc-bjj-debut|website=mmafighting.com|access-date=2026-06-08}}</ref> He won the match via rear-naked choke.<ref>{{Cite web|author=Kyle Dimond|date=2026-06-05|title=Gilbert Burns finally ends losing streak in first UFC match since retiring from MMA inside the Octagon|url=https://bloodyelbow.com/2026/06/05/gilbert-burns-finally-ends-losing-streak-in-first-ufc-match-since-retiring-from-mma-inside-the-octagon/|website=bloodyelbow.com|access-date=2026-05-08}}</ref>

==Mixed martial arts career==

===Early career===
After winning the 2011 World Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu Championships, Burns decided to make mixed martial arts his main focus and made his professional debut in January 2012.

===The Ultimate Fighter: Brazil===
In 2012, Burns was chosen by UFC fighter [[Vitor Belfort]] to be the head grappling coach for Team Vitor on the first season of [[The Ultimate Fighter: Brazil]].<ref>[http://www.graciemag.com/2012/05/the-2-jiu-jitsu-lessons-from-tuf-brazil-you-didnt-see-on-tv/ 2 Jiu-Jitsu lessons from TUF Brazil you didn't see on TV] {{Webarchive|url=https://web.archive.org/web/20160304030558/http://www.graciemag.com/2012/05/the-2-jiu-jitsu-lessons-from-tuf-brazil-you-didnt-see-on-tv/ |date=4 March 2016 }} graciemag.com (21 May 2012)</ref>

===Ultimate Fighting Championship===
====2014====
Burns made his debut on 26 July 2014 at [[UFC on Fox 12]], replacing an injured [[Viscardi Andrade]] against promotional newcomer Andreas Stahl.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://www.mmafighting.com/2014/5/22/5741800/gilbert-burns-replaces-injured-viscardi-andrade-at-ufc-on-fox-12 |title=Gilbert Burns replaces injured Viscardi Andrade at UFC on FOX 12 |publisher=mmafighting.com |author=Guilherme Cruz |access-date=2014-05-22 |date=2014-05-22}}</ref> He won the fight by unanimous decision.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://fansided.com/2014/07/26/ufc-fox-12-results-gilbert-burns-edges-andreas-stahl-via-decision/|title=UFC on FOX 12 results: Gilbert Burns edges Andreas Stahl via decision|date=July 26, 2014|author=Josh Sanchez|website=fansided.com}}</ref>

=====Return to Lightweight=====
Burns faced promotional newcomer [[Christos Giagos]] in a lightweight bout on 25 October 2014 at [[UFC 179]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.mmafighting.com/2014/9/9/6128539/rfa-champ-christos-giagos-signs-with-the-ufc-meets-gilbert-burns-in |title=RFA champ Christos Giagos signs with the UFC, meets Gilbert Burns in Brazil |author=Guilherme Cruz |publisher=mmafighting.com |access-date=2014-09-09 |date=2014-09-09}}</ref> He won the bout via submission in the first round.  The win also earned him his first ''Performance of the Night'' bonus award.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://mmajunkie.com/2014/10/ufc-179-bonuses-jose-aldo-chad-mendes-fabio-maldonado-gilbert-burns-win-50000 |title=UFC 179 bonuses: Jose Aldo, Chad Mendes, Fabio Maldonado, Gilbert Burns win $50,000 |publisher=mmajunkie.com |author=Staff |access-date=2014-10-26 |date=2014-10-26}}</ref>

====2015====
Burns was expected to face [[Josh Thomson]] on 21 March 2015 at [[UFC Fight Night 62]].<ref>{{cite news |url=http://cagepages.com/2015/01/21/josh-thomson-vs-gilbert-burns-slated-ufc-fight-night-62/ |title=Josh Thomson vs. Gilbert Burns slated for UFC Fight Night 62 |publisher=cagepages.com |author=Sean Bio |access-date=2014-05-09 |date=2014-05-09}}</ref>  However, on 26 February, Thomson pulled out of the fight with an undisclosed injury, and was replaced by [[Alex Oliveira (fighter)|Alex Oliveira]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.mmafighting.com/2015/2/26/8116635/josh-thomson-injured-out-of-ufc-fight-night-62-co-main-event-bout |title=Josh Thomson injured, out of UFC Fight Night 62 co-main event bout against Gilbert Burns |publisher=mmafighting.com |author=Guilherme Cruz |date=2015-02-26 |access-date=2015-02-26}}</ref>  After arguably dropping the first two rounds, Burns rallied to win the fight via submission in the third round.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://mmajunkie.com/2015/03/ufc-fight-night-62-results-gilbert-burns-struggles-but-eventually-taps-alex-oliveira |title=UFC Fight Night 62 results: Gilbert Burns struggles, but eventually taps Alex Oliveira |publisher=mmajunkie.com |author=Ben Fowlkes |date=2015-03-21 |access-date=2015-03-21}}</ref> This win also earned him his second straight ''Performance of the Night'' bonus.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2015/03/ufc-fight-night-62-bonuses-on-card-with-nine-stoppages-who-won-50000 |title=UFC Fight Night 62 bonuses: On card with nine stoppages, who won $50,000? |date=2015-03-22 |website=MMA Junkie |language=en |access-date=2019-10-29}}</ref>

Burns was expected to face [[Norman Parke]] on 30 May 2015 at [[UFC Fight Night 67]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://mmajunkie.com/2015/03/norman-parke-says-hes-fighting-gilbert-burns-at-ufc-fight-night-67-in-brazil |title=Norman Parke says he's fighting Gilbert Burns at UFC Fight Night 67 in Brazil |publisher=mmajunkie.com |author=Staff |date=2015-03-31 |access-date=2015-03-31}}</ref>  However, Burns pulled out of the fight due to injury in late April and was replaced by [[Francisco Trinaldo]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bloodyelbow.com/2015/4/27/8503849/gilbert-burns-injury-norman-parke-francisco-trinaldo-replacement-ufc-fight-night-67-ufc-news |title=Injury forces Gilbert Burns out of Norman Parke fight; Francisco Trinaldo steps up |publisher=bloodyelbow.com |author=Lucas Rezende |date=2015-04-27 |access-date=2015-04-27 |archive-date=29 April 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150429183748/http://www.bloodyelbow.com/2015/4/27/8503849/gilbert-burns-injury-norman-parke-francisco-trinaldo-replacement-ufc-fight-night-67-ufc-news |url-status=dead }}</ref>

Burns faced [[Rashid Magomedov]] at [[UFC Fight Night 77]] on 7 November 2015.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.bloodyelbow.com/2015/8/6/9111695/report-gilbert-burns-vs-rashid-magomedov-set-for-sao-paulo-in-november-ufc-news- |title=Gilbert Burns vs. Rashid Magomedov set for São Paulo in November |publisher=bloodyelbow.com |author=Lucas Rezende |date=2015-08-06 |access-date=2015-08-06 |archive-date=7 August 2015 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20150807192835/http://www.bloodyelbow.com/2015/8/6/9111695/report-gilbert-burns-vs-rashid-magomedov-set-for-sao-paulo-in-november-ufc-news- |url-status=dead }}</ref> After getting knocked down multiple times during the bout, he lost the first fight via unanimous decision, marking his first loss in his MMA career.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://www.sovsport.ru/news/text-item/856609 |title=Rashid Magomedov beat Brazilian BJJ World champion |publisher=sovsport.ru |author=Sergey Vashchenko |date=2015-08-11}}</ref>

====2016====
Burns next faced Łukasz Sajewski on 7 July 2016 at [[UFC Fight Night 90]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://mmajunkie.com/2016/05/ufc-fight-night-90-adds-number-of-new-bouts-including-mike-pyle-vs-alberto-mina |title=UFC Fight Night 90 adds number of new bouts |publisher=mmajunkie.com |author=Staff |date=2016-05-03 |access-date=2016-05-03}}</ref> He won the fight via submission in the closing seconds of the first round.<ref>{{cite web |url=http://mmajunkie.com/2016/07/ufc-fight-night-90-results-gilbert-burns-armbar-gets-lukasz-sajewski-to-tap-with-3-seconds-left-in-first |title=UFC Fight Night 90 results: Gilbert Burns' armbar gets Lukasz Sajewski to tap with 3 seconds left in first |publisher=mmajunkie.com |author=Ben Fowlkes |date=2016-07-07 |access-date=2016-07-07}}</ref>

Burns faced [[Michel Prazeres]] on 24 September 2016 at [[UFC Fight Night 95]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://mmajunkie.com/2016/08/burns-vs-prazeres-and-gillespie-vs-silva-added-to-ufc-fight-night-95-in-brazil |title=Gilbert Burns vs. Michel Prazeres added to UFC Fight Night 95 in Brazil |publisher=mmajunkie.com |author=Staff |date=2016-08-04 |access-date=2016-08-04}}</ref> He lost the fight via unanimous decision.<ref>{{cite news |url=http://mmajunkie.com/2016/09/ufc-fight-night-95-results-michel-prazeres-goes-to-judges-again-sweeps-gilbert-burns |title=UFC Fight Night 95 results: Michel Prazeres goes to judges again, sweeps Gilbert Burns |publisher=mmajunkie.com |author=Steven Marrocco |access-date=2016-09-24 |date=2016-09-24}}</ref>

====2017====
Burns was scheduled to meet [[Paul Felder]] on 11 February 2017 at [[UFC 208]].<ref>{{cite news |url=http://severemma.com/2016/12/paul-felder-super-excited-fighting-close-home-gilbert-burns-ufc-208/ |title=Paul Felder "super excited" to be fighting close to home against Gilbert Burns at UFC 208 |publisher=severemma.com |author=Niall McGrath |date=2016-12-19 |access-date=2016-12-19}}</ref> However, Burns pulled out of the fight in mid-January citing injury.<ref>{{cite web |title=Gilbert Burns injured, UFC seeking replacement for Paul Felder |url=https://mymmanews.com/paul-felder-ufc-208/ |publisher=mymmanews.com |author=Eric Kowal |date=2017-01-17 |access-date=2017-01-17}}</ref>

Burns faced [[Jason Saggo]] on 16 September 2017 at [[UFC Fight Night 116]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://www.fightful.com/multiple-fights-added-ufc-fight-night-pittsburgh |title=Multiple fights added To UFC Fight Night: Pittsburgh |publisher=fansided.com |author=David Tees |date=2017-07-23 |access-date=2017-07-23 |archive-date=17 September 2017 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20170917032337/https://www.fightful.com/multiple-fights-added-ufc-fight-night-pittsburgh |url-status=dead }}</ref> He won the fight via knockout in the second round.<ref>{{Cite news |url=http://mmajunkie.com/2017/09/ufc-pittsburgh-results-gilbert-burns-scores-walk-off-finish-of-jason-saggo |title=UFC-Pittsburgh results: Gilbert Burns scores thunderous walk-off KO of Jason Saggo |date=2017-09-17 |work=MMAjunkie |access-date=2017-09-17 |language=en-US}}</ref>

In the beginning of November 2017, Burns stated he had signed a new, four-fight contract with UFC.<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2017/11/2/16597448/gilbert-burns-signs-new-four-fight-deal-ufc |title=Gilbert Burns signs new four-fight deal with the UFC |date=2017-11-02 |author=Guilherme Cruz |publisher=mmafighting.com}}</ref>

====2018====
Burns was scheduled to face [[Olivier Aubin-Mercier]] on 24 February 2018 at [[UFC on Fox 28]].<ref>{{Cite news |url=http://mmajunkie.com/2017/12/olivier-aubin-mercier-vs-gilbert-burns-booked-for-ufc-on-fox-28 |title=Olivier Aubin-Mercier vs. Gilbert Burns booked for UFC on FOX 28 |date=2017-12-15 |work=MMAjunkie |access-date=2017-12-15 |language=en-US}}</ref> However, on 21 February 2018, both Burns and Aubin-Mercier were pulled from the card, as promotional medical team deemed Burns would be unsafe to meet lightweight upper limit of 156 Ibs limit upon his arrival at the fight week.<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2018/2/21/17036504/gilbert-burns-vs-olivier-aubin-mercier-scratched-from-ufc-on-fox-28 |title=Gilbert Burns vs. Olivier Aubin-Mercier scratched from UFC on FOX 28 |work=MMA Fighting |access-date=2018-02-21}}</ref>

Burns was linked to a fight with [[Lando Vannata]] on 14 April 2018 at [[UFC on Fox 29]].<ref>{{cite web |url=http://mmadna.nl/gilbert-burns-vecht-tegen-lando-vannata-tijdens-ufc-on-fox-29-in-glendale/ |title=Gilbert Burns vecht tegen Lando Vannata tijdens UFC on FOX 29 in Glendale |last=DNA |first=MMA |website=mmadna.nl |date=23 February 2018 |language=en-US |access-date=2018-02-23}}</ref> However, the pairing never materialized as Vannata was unable to accept the fight for this date/event as he was still rehabilitating a recent arm injury,<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.bloodyelbow.com/2018/3/18/17135450/mma-news-gilbert-burns-vs-lando-vannata-not-happening-ufc-on-fox-29 |title=Gilbert Burns vs. Lando Vannata not happening at UFC on FOX 29 |publisher=bloodyelbow.com |author=Mookie Alexander |date=2018-03-18 |access-date=2018-03-18 |archive-date=29 June 2018 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20180629102300/https://www.bloodyelbow.com/2018/3/18/17135450/mma-news-gilbert-burns-vs-lando-vannata-not-happening-ufc-on-fox-29 |url-status=dead }}</ref> instead Burns was scheduled to face newcomer Dan Moret in this event.<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2018/3/27/17167512/gilbert-burns-faces-octagon-newcomer-dan-moret-ufc-on-fox-29-glendale |title=Gilbert Burns faces Octagon newcomer Dan Moret at UFC on FOX 29 |work=MMA Fighting |access-date=2018-03-28}}</ref> He won the fight via knockout one minute into the second round.<ref>{{Cite news |url=http://mmajunkie.com/2018/04/ufc-on-fox-29-results-gilbert-burns-scores-walk-off-finish-of-dan-moret |title=UFC&nbsp;on FOX 29 results: Gilbert Burns scores walk-off finish of Dan Moret |date=2018-04-14 |work=MMAjunkie |access-date=2018-04-15 |language=en-US}}</ref>

Burns faced [[Dan Hooker]] on 7 July 2018 at [[UFC 226]].<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://mmajunkie.com/2018/05/gilbert-burns-dan-hooker-slated-ufc-226-las-vegas |title=Gilbert Burns vs. Dan Hooker slated for UFC 226 in Las Vegas |date=2018-05-19 |work=MMAjunkie |access-date=2018-05-19 |language=en-US}}</ref> He lost the fight via knockout in the first round, being finished for the first time in his MMA career.<ref>{{Cite news |url=https://mmajunkie.com/2018/07/ufc-226-results-dan-hooker-knocks-out-gilbert-burns-for-fourth-straight-finish |title=UFC 226 results: Dan Hooker knocks out Gilbert Burns for fourth straight finish |date=2018-07-08 |work=MMAjunkie |access-date=2018-07-08 |language=en-US}}</ref>

The bout with [[Olivier Aubin-Mercier]] was rescheduled and eventually took place on 8 December 2018 at [[UFC 231]].<ref>{{cite news |url=https://mmajunkie.com/2018/08/gilbert-burns-vs-olivier-aubin-mercier-ufc-231-toronto |title=Gilbert Burns vs. Olivier Aubin-Mercier re-booked for UFC 231 in Toronto |publisher=mmajunkie.com |author=Staff |date=2018-08-22 |access-date=2018-08-22}}</ref> Burns won the fight by unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2018/12/8/18132509/ufc-231-results-gilbert-burns-cruises-to-decision-over-olivier-aubin-mercier |title=UFC 231 results: Gilbert Burns cruises to decision over Olivier Aubin-Mercier |last=Doyle |first=Dave |date=2018-12-08 |website=MMA Fighting |access-date=2018-12-09}}</ref>

====2019====
Burns was expected to face returning veteran [[Eric Wisely]] on 27 April 2019 at [[UFC Fight Night 150]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://sportv.globo.com/site/combate/noticia/ultimate-encaminha-gilbert-durinho-x-eric-wisely-no-ufc-fort-lauderdale-27-de-abril.ghtml |title=UFC sets Gilbert Durinho vs. Eric Wisely at UFC Fort Lauderdale, April 27 |publisher=sportv.globo.com |author=Raphael Marinho |date=2019-03-29 |access-date=2019-03-29 |language=pt |archive-date=29 March 2019 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20190329190434/https://sportv.globo.com/site/combate/noticia/ultimate-encaminha-gilbert-durinho-x-eric-wisely-no-ufc-fort-lauderdale-27-de-abril.ghtml |url-status=dead }}</ref> However, it was reported on 18 April that Wisely pulled out of the bout, citing injury. He was replaced by newcomer [[Mike Davis (fighter)|Mike Davis]].<ref name="MikeDavis">{{Cite web |url=http://mmadna.nl/short-notice-ufc-debuut-voor-mike-davis-tegen-gilbert-burns-tijdens-ufc-fort-lauderdale/ |title=Short notice UFC debut for Mike Davis against Gilbert Burns during UFC Fort Lauderdale |publisher=mmadna.nl |author=Marcel Dorff |access-date=2019-04-19 |date=2019-04-18 |language=nl}}</ref> Burns won the fight via rear-naked choke submission in the second round.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2019/04/27/ufc-fort-lauderdale-results-gilbert-burns/ |title=UFC Fort Lauderdale Results: Gilbert Burns Utilizes Superior Grappling to Submit Mike Davis |last=Doherty |first=Dan |date=2019-04-27 |website=Cageside Press |language=en-US |access-date=2019-04-29}}</ref>

Burns returned to the welterweight facing [[Alexey Kunchenko]] on 10 August 2019 at [[UFC Fight Night 156]], replacing injured [[Laureano Staropoli]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://mmadna.nl/gilbert-burns-pakt-short-notice-gevecht-tegen-alexey-kunchenko-tijdens-ufc-montevideo/ |title=Gilbert Burns pakt short notice gevecht tegen Alexey Kunchenko tijdens UFC Montevideo |last=DNA |first=MMA |date=30 July 2019 |language=en-US |access-date=2019-07-30}}</ref> He won the fight via unanimous decision, marking Kunchenko's first loss in his career.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2019/08/10/ufc-uruguay-results-gilbert-burns-alexey-kunchenko-first-loss/ |title=UFC Uruguay Results: Gilbert Burns Gives Alexey Kunchenko First Career Loss |last=Harshman |first=Heath |date=2019-08-10 |website=Cageside Press |language=en-US |access-date=2019-08-11}}</ref>

Burns stepped in as a late replacement to face [[Gunnar Nelson (fighter)|Gunnar Nelson]], on 28 September 2019 at [[UFC Fight Night 160]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://mmadna.nl/gilbert-burns-vervangt-thiago-alves-tegen-gunnar-nelson-tijdens-ufc-kopenhagen/ |title=Gilbert Burns vervangt Thiago Alves tegen Gunnar Nelson tijdens UFC Kopenhagen |author=Marcel Dorff |date=15 September 2019 |language=nl |access-date=2022-08-03}}</ref> He won the fight via unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2019/09/28/ufc-copenhagen-results-gunnar-nelson-vs-gilbert-burns/ |title=UFC Copenhagen Results: Gilbert Burns Wins Decision Over Gunnar Nelson |last=Anderson |first=Jay |date=2019-09-28 |website=Cageside Press |language=en-US |access-date=2019-09-29}}</ref>

====2020====
As the first fight of his new, four-fight contract, Burns faced [[Demian Maia]] on 14 March 2020 at [[UFC Fight Night 170]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://mmainsight.com/ufc/demian-maia-to-fight-gilbert-burns-at-ufc-fight-night-170 |title=Demian Maia To Fight Gilbert Burns At UFC Fight Night 170 |last=Cole |first=Ross |date=2020-01-05 |website=MMA Insight |language=en-US |access-date=2020-01-05}}</ref><ref>{{cite tweet |user=GilbertDurinho |number=1214749383675256832 |title=Now it's official contract is signed! I'm fighting Demian Maia March 14 Co-main event March 14 in 🇧🇷 and also I renew my contract to 4 more fights thanks @ufc huge thanks to @seanshelby @danawhite and my manager best in the business @AliAbdelaziz00 #BlessedAndGrateful #2020Vision |date=8 January 2020}}</ref> He won the fight via technical knockout in round one.<ref>{{Cite web |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2020/03/14/ufc-brasilia-results-gilbert-burns-vs-demian-maia/ |title=UFC Brasilia Results: Gilbert Burns Knocks Out Maia, Calls Out Covington |last=Gibbons |first=Justin |date=2020-03-14 |website=Cageside Press |language=en-US |access-date=2020-03-15}}</ref> This win earned him the ''[[List of UFC bonus award recipients|Performance of the Night]]'' award.<ref name="UFN170">{{cite web |title=UFC Brasilia Bonuses: Gilbert Burns topples Demian Maia for $50,000 |url=https://www.mmaweekly.com/ufc-brasilia-fighter-bonuses-gilbert-burns-stops-demian-maia-to-take-the-torch-and-50k |publisher=mmaweekly.com |author=Staff |date=2020-03-14 |access-date=2020-03-14}}</ref>

Burns faced [[Tyron Woodley]] on 30 May 2020 in the main event of [[UFC on ESPN 9]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Tyron Woodley to fight Gilbert Burns at UFC Fight Night on May 30 |url=https://www.espn.com/mma/story/_/id/29194139/sources-tyron-woodley-fight-gilbert-burns-ufc-fight-night-30 |website=ESPN |date=19 May 2020 |language=en-US |access-date=2020-05-19}}</ref> After knocking Woodley down in the first round and mostly dominating the former champion throughout the fight, Burns won the fight via unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web |title=UFC Vegas Results: Gilbert Burns Dominates Tyron Woodley |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2020/05/31/ufc-vegas-results-gilbert-burns-dominates-tyron-woodley/ |last=Evanoff |first=Josh |date=2020-05-31 |website=Cageside Press |language=en-US |access-date=2020-05-31}}</ref> This win also earned him his fourth ''[[List of UFC bonus award recipients|Performance of the Night]]'' award.<ref name="UFConESPN9">{{Cite web |title=UFC Las Vegas bonuses: Dern's record-setting kneebar wins POTN |url=https://www.bloodyelbow.com/2020/5/31/21275717/ufc-las-vegas-post-fight-bonuses-derns-record-setting-kneebar-wins-potn |last=Haynes |first=Stephie |date=2020-05-31 |website=Bloody Elbow |language=en |access-date=2020-05-31 |archive-date=8 June 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200608180759/https://www.bloodyelbow.com/2020/5/31/21275717/ufc-las-vegas-post-fight-bonuses-derns-record-setting-kneebar-wins-potn |url-status=dead }}</ref>

====2021====
As the first bout of his new five-fight contract, Burns was scheduled to face [[Kamaru Usman]] for the [[UFC Welterweight Championship]] on 11 July 2021 at [[UFC 251]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2020/06/ufc-251-kamaru-usman-vs-gilbert-burns-booked-to-headline/amp |title=Kamaru Usman vs. Gilbert Burns headlines UFC 251 on 'Fight Island' in Abu Dhabi |work=MMAFighting.com |date=9 June 2020 |author=Farah Hannoun |access-date=9 June 2020 |archive-date=9 June 2020 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20200609181919/https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2020/06/ufc-251-kamaru-usman-vs-gilbert-burns-booked-to-headline/amp |url-status=dead }}</ref><ref>{{cite web |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2020/6/25/21302496/gilbert-burns-happy-with-pay-for-ufc-251-jorge-masvidal-claims-he-took-lowest-money-possible |title=Gilbert Burns 'happy' with pay for UFC 251, Jorge Masvidal claims he took 'lowest money possible' |author=Damon Martin |publisher=mmafighting.com |date=25 June 2020}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2021/11/17/22786232/gilbert-burns-khamzat-chimaev-doesnt-make-sense-but-want-to-fight|title=Gilbert Burns: Facing Khamzat Chimaev 'doesn't make sense,' but it would be 'hard for me to say no to a fight'|date=November 17, 2021|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Guilherme Cruz}}</ref> However, on 3 July 2020, it was revealed that Burns tested positive for [[Coronavirus disease 2019|COVID-19]], and he was subsequently removed from the card, and replaced by [[Jorge Masvidal]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-07-04 |title=Gilbert Burns tests positive for COVID-19, out of UFC 251 headliner vs. Kamaru Usman |url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2020/07/ufc-251-gilbert-burns-out-kamaru-usman-title-fight-coronavirus |access-date=2020-07-04 |website=MMA Junkie |language=en}}</ref> The title bout with [[Kamaru Usman|Usman]] was rescheduled for 12 December 2021, at [[UFC 256]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-09-01 |title=BREAKING: Kamaru Usman vs. Gilbert Burns Set For UFC 256, Jorge Masvidal vs. Nate Diaz 2 In The Works |url=https://www.mmanews.com/breaking-kamaru-usman-vs-gilbert-burns-jorge-masvidal-vs-nate-diaz-2-reported-for-ufc-256/ |access-date=2020-09-02 |website=MMA News |language=en-US}}</ref> However, on 5 October 2020, it was reported Usman pulled from his bout, citing more time needed to recover from undisclosed injuries and the bout was postponed to an unknown future date.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2020-10-05 |title=Sources: Usman-Burns fight on Dec. 12 is off |url=https://www.espn.com/mma/story/_/id/30048745/sources-kamaru-usman-gilbert-burns-fight-happen-dec-12 |access-date=2020-10-06 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}}</ref> The bout with Usman took place on 13 February 2021 at [[UFC 258]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.espn.com/mma/story/_/id/30652117/kamaru-usman-gilbert-burns-headline-ufc-258-sources-say|title=Kamaru Usman-Gilbert Burns to headline UFC 258, sources say|date=January 5, 2021|author=Brett Okamoto|work=[[ESPN]]}}</ref> Burns knocked Usman down early in the fight, but went on to lose the bout via technical knockout in the third round.<ref>{{Cite web|last=Martin |first=Damon|date=2021-02-13|title=Kamaru Usman survives early scare, finishes Gilbert Burns with barrage of punches in UFC 258 main event|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2021/2/14/22282570/kamaru-usman-survives-early-scare-finishes-gilbert-burns-with-barrage-of-punches-ufc-258-main-event|access-date=2021-02-13|website=MMA Fighting|language=en}}</ref>

Burns faced [[Stephen Thompson (fighter)|Stephen Thompson]] on 10 July 2021 at [[UFC 264]].<ref>{{Cite web |date=2021-04-03 |title=Gilbert Burns vs. Stephen Thompson booked for UFC 264 in July |url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2021/04/ufc-news-gilbert-burns-vs-stephen-thompson-welterweight-booked-ufc-264-july |access-date=2021-04-03 |website=MMA Junkie |language=en-US}}</ref> He won the fight via unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Anderson |first=Jay |date=2021-07-11 |title=UFC 264 Results: Gilbert Burns Survives Late Scare, Earns Decision Over Stephen Thompson |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2021/07/11/ufc-264-results-gilbert-burns-vs-stephen-thompson/ |access-date=2021-07-11 |website=Cageside Press |language=en-US}}</ref>

====2022====
Burns faced [[Khamzat Chimaev]] at [[UFC 273]] on 9 April 2022.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-03-03 |title=UFC 273 Burns vs. Chimaev vindt plaats in Jacksonville, Florida |url=https://www.eurosport.nl/mixed-martial-arts/ufc/2022/ufc-273-burns-vs.-chimaev-vindt-plaats-in-jacksonville-florida_sto8822445/story.shtml |access-date=2022-03-04 |website=Eurosport|author=Dorff Marcel|language=nl}}</ref> He lost the bout via unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Anderson |first=Jay |date=2022-04-10 |title=UFC 273: Khamzat Chimaev Battles Past Gilbert Burns in Fight of the Year Candidate |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2022/04/10/ufc-273-gilbert-burns-vs-khamzat-chimaev/ |access-date=2022-04-10 |website=Cageside Press |language=en-US}}</ref> The fight was awarded the ''[[List of UFC bonus award recipients|Fight of the Night]]'' award.<ref name="UFC273">{{Cite web |last=Newswire |first=MMA Fighting |date=2022-04-10 |title=UFC 273 post-fight bonuses: Khamzat Chimaev vs. Gilbert Burns wins 'Fight of the Night' |url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2022/4/10/23018702/ufc-273-post-fight-bonuses-khamzat-chimaev-vs-gilbert-burns-wins-fight-of-the-night |access-date=2022-04-10 |website=MMA Fighting |language=en}}</ref> [[Dana White]] later announced that Burns would get his win bonus for the fight, despite the loss.<ref>{{cite web | url=https://www.mirror.co.uk/sport/other-sports/mma/khamzat-chimaev-gilbert-burns-ufc-26678196 | title=Gilbert Burns paid win bonus despite losing to Khamzat Chimaev at UFC 273 | website=[[Daily Mirror]] | date=10 April 2022 }}</ref>

====2023====
Burns faced [[Neil Magny]] on 21 January 2023 at [[UFC 283]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.bjpenn.com/mma-news/ufc/gilbert-burns-to-face-neil-magny-at-ufc-283-in-brazil-after-jorge-masvidal-allegedly-turned-him-down/|title=Gilbert Burns to face Neil Magny at UFC 283 in Brazil after Jorge Masvidal allegedly turned him down|publisher={{!}} BJPenn.com|author=Cole Shelton|date=2022-11-23|access-date=2022-11-23}}</ref> He won the fight via an arm-triangle choke submission in the first round.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2023/01/21/ufc-283-gilbert-burns-vs-neil-magny/|title=UFC 283: Gilbert Burns returns to win column with Sub of Neil Magny|website=Cageside Press|author=Dylan Rush|date=2023-01-21|access-date=2023-01-22}}</ref>

Burns faced [[Jorge Masvidal]] on 8 April 2023 at [[UFC 287]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Anderson |first=Jay |date=2023-01-27 |title=UFC 287 Gets Pereira vs. Adesanya 2, Burns vs. Masvidal, Holland vs. Ponzinibbio |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2023/01/27/ufc-287-gets-pereira-vs-adesanya-2-burns-vs-masvidal/ |access-date=2023-01-27 |website=Cageside Press |language=en-US}}</ref> He won the bout via unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Dewar |first=Val |date=2023-04-09 |title=UFC 287: Gilbert Burns Wins Decision, Jorge Masvidal Retires in Hometown of Miami |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2023/04/09/ufc-287-gilbert-burns-wins-decision-jorge-masvidal-retires-in-hometown-of-miami/ |access-date=2023-04-09 |website=Cageside Press |language=en-US}}</ref>

Burns faced [[Belal Muhammad]] on 6 May 2023 at [[UFC 288]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Raimondi |first=Marc |date=2023-04-21 |title=Gilbert Burns and Belal Muhammad now co-headlining UFC 288 in May |url=https://www.espn.com.au/mma/ufc/story/_/id/36249919/gilbert-burns-belal-muhammad-now-co-headlining-ufc-288-may |access-date=2023-04-21 |website=ESPN |language=en-US}}</ref> He lost the bout by unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Rush |first=Dylan |date=2023-05-07 |title=UFC 288: Belal Muhammad Earns Decision, Title Shot Against Injured Gilbert Burns |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2023/05/07/ufc-288-belal-muhammad-vs-gilbert-burns/ |access-date=2023-06-07 |website=Cageside Press |language=en-US}}</ref>

==== 2024 ====
Burns faced [[Jack Della Maddalena]] on 9 March 2024 at [[UFC 299]].<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/2023/12/17/24004731/ufc-299-fight-announcements-michael-venom-page-vs-kevin-holland-ian-machado-garry-vs-geoff-neal-more|title=UFC 299 fight card: Michael 'Venom' Page joins UFC, will fight in Miami against Kevin Holland|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Steven Marracco|date=2023-12-17|access-date=2023-12-17}}</ref> He lost the bout via knockout in round three.<ref>{{Cite web |last=Law |first=Eddie |date=2024-03-10 |title=Jack Della Maddalena Scores Comeback KO Over Burns |url=https://cagesidepress.com/2024/03/09/jack-della-maddalena-scores-comeback-ko-over-burns/ |access-date=2024-03-10 |website=Cageside Press |language=en-US}}</ref>

Burns faced [[Sean Brady (fighter)|Sean Brady]] on 7 September 2024 at [[UFC Fight Night 242]] in the main event.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2024-06-10 |title=Gilbert Burns vs. Sean Brady targeted for UFC Fight Night main event on Sept. 7 |url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2024/06/ufc-news-gilbert-burns-vs-sean-brady-targeted-fight-night-main-event-sept-7 |access-date=2024-06-10 |website=MMA Junkie |language=en-US}}</ref> He lost the fight by unanimous decision.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2024/09/07/sean-brady-grinds-burns-to-decision-victory-calls-out-garry/|title=Sean Brady Grinds Burns To Decision Victory, Calls Out Garry|publisher=cagesidepress.com|author=Eddie Law|date=2024-09-07|access-date=2024-09-07}}</ref>

==== 2025 ====
Burns was scheduled to face undefeated prospect [[Michael Morales (fighter)|Michael Morales]] on 12 April 2025, at [[UFC 314]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.lowkickmma.com/gilbert-burns-fights-against-ko-star-ufc-314/|title=Report – Gilbert Burns books return fight against unbeaten KO star at UFC 314 in Miami|publisher=lowkickmma.com|author=Ross Markey|date=2025-01-09|access-date=2025-02-19}}</ref> However, the bout was moved to 10 May 2025 at [[UFC 315]] for unknown reasons.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/2025/02/ufc-315-fight-card-montreal-muhammad-della-maddalenna-shevchenko-fiorot|title=UFC 315 title fights revealed: Belal Muhammad, Valentina Shevchenko set to defend in Montreal|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Nolan King|date=2025-02-19|access-date=2025-02-19}}</ref> In turn, the bout against Morales was moved to serve as the main event on 17 May 2025 at [[UFC Fight Night 256]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://athlonsports.com/mma/ufc-vegas-106-gilbert-burns-vs-michael-morales|title=UFC Vegas 106 Adds a High-Stakes Test for Undefeated Prospect – Top 10 Spot in Reach|publisher=athlonsports.net|author=Prince Horton|date=2025-04-11|access-date=2025-04-11}}</ref> Burns lost the fight by technical knockout in the first round.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://cagesidepress.com/2025/05/17/ufc-vegas-106-michael-morales-now-18-0-after-wrecking-gilbert-burns/|title=UFC Vegas 106: Michael Morales Now 18-0 After Wrecking Gilbert Burns|publisher=cagesidepress.com|author=Jay Anderson|date=2025-05-17|access-date=2025-05-17}}</ref>

====2026====
Burns faced [[Mike Malott]] in the main event on 18 April 2026, at [[UFC Fight Night 273]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://mmajunkie.usatoday.com/story/sports/ufc/2026/02/20/ufc-returns-winnipeg-gilbert-burns-vs-mike-malott-main-event/88782064007/|title=Gilbert Burns vs Mike Malott headlines UFC Fight Night 273 in Winnipeg|publisher=mmajunkie.usatoday.com|author=Mike Bohn|date=2026-02-20|access-date=2026-04-19}}</ref> He lost the fight by technical knockout in the third round and laid down his gloves after the bout signaling his retirement from mixed martial arts.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://bloodyelbow.com/2026/04/18/gilbert-burns-vs-mike-malott-ufc-winnipeg-result-brazilian-legend/|title=Gilbert Burns vs Mike Malott UFC Winnipeg result: Brazilian legend knocked out on historic night in Canada|publisher=bloodyelbow.com|author=Donagh Corby|date=2026-04-18|access-date=2026-04-19}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/ufc-news/437855/highlights-mike-malott-uppercuts-gilbert-burns-into-retirement-at-ufc-winnipeg|title=Highlights! Mike Malott uppercuts Gilbert Burns into retirement at UFC Winnipeg|publisher=mmamania.com|author=Ryan Harkness|date=2026-04-19|access-date=2026-04-19}}</ref><ref>{{cite web |last1=de Souza |first1=Diogo |title=Gilbert Burns Announces Retirement From MMA At UFC Winnipeg |url=https://jitsmagazine.com/gilbert-burns-announces-retirement-from-mma-at-ufc-winnipeg/ |website=Jits Magazine |access-date=20 April 2026}}</ref>

==Freestyle Wrestling==
Burns faced [[Khamzat Chimaev]] on 18 September 2026 at [[RAF 13]].<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmamania.com/raf-wrestling-schedule-cards-live-results/469124/rematch-khamzat-chimaev-vs-gilbert-burns-2-raf-13-miami|title=Rematch! Khamzat Chimaev vs. Gilbert Burns 2 set for RAF 13 in Miami|publisher=mmamania.com|author=Jesse Holland|date=2026-09-02|access-date=2026-09-03}}</ref> He lost the match by technical fall in the second round.<ref>{{Cite web|url=https://www.mmafighting.com/ufc/510981/raf-13-results-khamzat-chimaev-puts-up-15-points-to-earn-technical-fall-victory-over-gilbert-burns|title=RAF 13 results: Khamzat Chimaev puts up 15 points to earn technical fall victory over Gilbert Burns|publisher=mmafighting.com|author=Damon Martin|date=2026-09-19|access-date=2026-09-19}}</ref>
